name: Necromancer Chronic Diseases lengthens its masked diseases by 20% (#1761)
contract: Chronic Diseases 300749 ('Rank 2', description 'Increases all diseases durations by $s1%') has no CharacterAdvancement entry: its only rank chain is the orphaned Talent.dbc row 27266 (TabID 0, rank 1 = Death Commander 300235) and its SkillLineAbility row 760268 has AcquireMethod 0, so the live catalog offers it to no player; this scenario learns it as a fixture. Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20%, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x20) in SpellFamilyName 29, which covers the diseases Flesh to Worms 500338, Harvest Plague 500968 and Plague of Undeath 801945 (family flags word 2 bit 0x20). Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies the caster's SPELLMOD_DURATION natively and the aura is not one of the family-29 aura 42/354 effects the Necromancer contract turns into dummies, so no script is required. Flesh to Worms has DurationIndex 85 = 18000 ms: an untalented control's application must last 18000 ms, the application of a Necromancer holding Chronic Diseases 21600 ms. The DBC mask does not include Blight 500217, Crypt Plague 570131 or Lichplague 802132, so this scenario does not claim 'all diseases'.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Chronic Diseases passive aura is applied
SETUP: the control's Flesh to Worms lands
CONTROL: Flesh to Worms keeps its 18 second duration
Chronic Diseases applies Flesh to Worms
SETUP: the talented Flesh to Worms lands
DISCRIMINATING: Chronic Diseases extends Flesh to Worms to 21.6 seconds
